-- ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
--
--      CanTops CTS-WLAN Private MIB
--
--      Enterprise OID : .1.3.6.1.4.1.66620   (IANA PEN 66620, CanTops Co., LTD.)
--      Product        : .1.3.6.1.4.1.66620.1 (product 1 = CTS-WLAN)
--
--      The OID tree mirrors the CONTEC FXE3000 Private MIB (.1.3.6.1.4.1.672.65)
--      arc-for-arc, so a manager that already polls FXE3000 can reach the same
--      objects here by swapping only the two leading enterprise arcs. Both roots
--      are served in parallel during the migration period.
--
--      This module declares ONLY the objects this product actually serves.
--      Objects present in the FXE3000 MIB but not implemented here are listed at
--      the end of this file with the reason, so a manager never polls an OID that
--      is guaranteed to return noSuchInstance.
--
-- ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

CANTOPS-CTS-WLAN-MIB DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN

IMPORTS
    MODULE-IDENTITY, OBJECT-TYPE, NOTIFICATION-TYPE,
    enterprises, Counter32, IpAddress               FROM SNMPv2-SMI
    DisplayString                                   FROM SNMPv2-TC;

--
-- .1.3.6.1.4.1.66620.1
--
cantops         OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { enterprises 66620 }
ctsWlan         OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { cantops 1 }

ctsWlanMIB MODULE-IDENTITY
    LAST-UPDATED    "202608310000Z"
    ORGANIZATION    "CanTops Co., LTD."
    CONTACT-INFO    ""
    DESCRIPTION     "The MIB module for CTS-WLAN series."
    ::= { ctsWlan 1 }

ctsWlanTraps            OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanMIB 1 }
ctsWlanEnvironment      OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlan 2 }
ctsWlanStatus           OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlan 3 }
ctsWlanStatusInfo       OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanStatus 1 }
ctsWlanIfTable          OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanStatus 2 }
ctsWlanIfEntry          OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanIfTable 1 }
ctsWlanWirelessIf       OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanStatus 3 }
ctsWlanWIFInfo          OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanWirelessIf 1 }
ctsWlanWIFInfoAp        OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 10 }
ctsWlanWIFInfoStation   OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 11 }
ctsWlanWIFStatistics    OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { ctsWlanWirelessIf 2 }

--
-- ctsWlanEnvironment(2)
--

ctsWlanFirmwareVersion OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Version of Firmware. Package version of wlan-proc."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 2 }

ctsWlanHardwareVersion OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Version of Hardware. Empty when the device is not provisioned."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 3 }

ctsWlanEthernetAddress OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Ethernet Address, rendered as colon-separated hex text
         (for example 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff').
         NOTE: the FXE3000 MIB types this object as MacAddress
         (OCTET STRING (SIZE (6)), six raw bytes). This implementation returns
         printable text instead, so the type is declared here as it is actually
         served rather than as FXE3000 declares it. Migrating to the raw 6-byte
         form requires replacing the pass_persist backend with an AgentX
         subagent; tracked in wlan-package issue #215."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 4 }

ctsWlanWLMacAddress OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Wireless MAC Address, colon-separated hex text. See
                 ctsWlanEthernetAddress for the encoding note."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 5 }

ctsWlanIPAddress OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      IpAddress
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "IP Address of the wired management interface."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 6 }

ctsWlanSubnetMask OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      IpAddress
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Subnet Mask of the wired management interface."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 7 }

ctsWlanDefaultGateway OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      IpAddress
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Default Gateway Address of the wired management interface."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 8 }

ctsWlanProductNumber OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Product Number. Zero when unknown or out of Integer32 range."
    ::= { ctsWlanEnvironment 9 }

--
-- ctsWlanStatus(3).ctsWlanStatusInfo(1)
--
-- These are derived from link state, not read from physical LED hardware.
--

ctsWlanLedPower OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { on(1), off(2) }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "POWER LED status. Constant on(1): answering SNMP implies power on."
    ::= { ctsWlanStatusInfo 1 }

ctsWlanLedLan OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { on(1), off(2) }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "LAN LED status, derived from the wired carrier state."
    ::= { ctsWlanStatusInfo 2 }

ctsWlanLedWlan OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { on(1), off(2) }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "WLAN LED status, derived from the wireless association state."
    ::= { ctsWlanStatusInfo 3 }

--
-- ctsWlanStatus(3).ctsWlanIfTable(2)
--
-- Degenerate pseudo-table (no INDEX clause), mirroring FXE3000:
--   instance 1 = wired interface, instance 2 = wireless interface.
--

ctsWlanIfIndex OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Interface. 1 = wired, 2 = wireless."
    ::= { ctsWlanIfEntry 1 }

ctsWlanIfLinkStatus OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { up(1), down(2) }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Link State."
    ::= { ctsWlanIfEntry 7 }

--
-- ctsWlanStatus(3).ctsWlanWirelessIf(3).ctsWlanWIFInfo(1)
--

ctsWlanWIFInfoWirelessMode OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Wireless LAN Standard, derived from the negotiated tx bitrate
                 (for example '11ax')."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 1 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoWLM OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Wireless Link Mode. Constant 'managed': this product is a station."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 2 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoUnitType OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Unit Type. Constant 'Station'."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 3 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoWLMacAddress OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Wireless MAC Address, colon-separated hex text. See
                 ctsWlanEthernetAddress for the encoding note."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 4 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoBandWidth OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Band Width of the current association (for example '80 MHz')."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfo 5 }

--
-- ctsWlanWIFInfo(1).ctsWlanWIFInfoAp(10)
--
-- FXE3000 groups these under the access-point role. This product is a station,
-- so they report the ACCESS POINT IT IS ASSOCIATED WITH. They are served because
-- the ChannelChange notification names ctsWlanWIFInfoApChannel in its OBJECTS
-- clause: a manager receiving that trap must be able to GET the same OID.
--

ctsWlanWIFInfoApEssId OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "ESSID of the associated access point. Same value as
                 ctsWlanWIFInfoStaEssId."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoAp 1 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoApChannel OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Channel Number currently in use. Same value as
                 ctsWlanWIFInfoStaChannel. Carried by ctsWlanTrapChannelChange."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoAp 2 }

--
-- ctsWlanWIFInfo(1).ctsWlanWIFInfoStation(11)
--

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaLoginState OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER { notConnected(1), connected(2) }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Login State."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 1 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaApMacAddress OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "MAC Address of login AP (BSSID), colon-separated hex text. See
                 ctsWlanEthernetAddress for the encoding note."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 2 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaEssId OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "ESSID of the associated access point."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 3 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaChannel OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Channel Number."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 4 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaTxRate OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Tx Rate in Mbps."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 5 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaRxRate OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Rx Rate in Mbps."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 6 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaRssi OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "RSSI in dBm (negative). Zero when not associated."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 7 }

ctsWlanWIFInfoStaSupplicantState OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      INTEGER {
                    invalid(1),
                    success(2),
                    failure(3),
                    authenticating(4)
                }
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Supplicant State."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFInfoStation 8 }

--
-- ctsWlanWirelessIf(3).ctsWlanWIFStatistics(2)
--
-- Counters are absent (noSuchInstance) rather than zero when the driver does not
-- report them, because a zero would look like a counter reset to a manager.
-- Octet counters reset to zero on reassociation, which a manager may observe as
-- a spurious Counter32 wrap; filter on deltas accordingly.
--

ctsWlanWIFStatTxUnicast OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of tx unicast packets. Derived by subtracting group
                 frames from total transmitted frames; management frames and
                 fragments are included, so this may over-count."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 1 }

ctsWlanWIFStatTxMulticast OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of tx multicast packets."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 2 }

ctsWlanWIFStatTxUniOctets OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of tx unicast octets. Approximated from interface tx
                 bytes, so multicast octets are included."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 3 }

ctsWlanWIFStatTxShortRetries OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of tx signal retries, taken from dot11RetryCount. This
                 does not map one-to-one onto the 802.11 short-retry definition."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 5 }

ctsWlanWIFStatTxLongRetries OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of tx multiple retries, taken from
                 dot11MultipleRetryCount. See ctsWlanWIFStatTxShortRetries."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 6 }

ctsWlanWIFStatRxUnicast OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of rx unicast packets. Derived by subtracting group
                 frames from received fragments; see ctsWlanWIFStatTxUnicast."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 8 }

ctsWlanWIFStatRxMulticast OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of rx multicast packets."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 9 }

ctsWlanWIFStatRxUniOctets OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of rx unicast octets. Approximated from interface rx
                 bytes, so multicast octets are included."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 10 }

ctsWlanWIFStatRxHwFCSErrors OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    ACCESS      read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Number of rx hardware FCS errors. Absolute value accumulates
                 from boot; interpret as a delta."
    ::= { ctsWlanWIFStatistics 13 }

--
-- ctsWlanMIB(1).ctsWlanTraps(1)
--

ctsWlanTrapLinkStatusChange NOTIFICATION-TYPE
    OBJECTS { ctsWlanIfIndex, ctsWlanIfLinkStatus }
    STATUS  current
    DESCRIPTION "Trap of the link state transition."
    ::= { ctsWlanTraps 1 }

ctsWlanTrapChannelChange NOTIFICATION-TYPE
    OBJECTS { ctsWlanWIFInfoApChannel }
    STATUS  current
    DESCRIPTION "Trap of the DFS channel change."
    ::= { ctsWlanTraps 2 }

--
-- ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
--  Objects defined by the CONTEC FXE3000 MIB but NOT served by this product.
--  Listed for traceability; polling them returns noSuchInstance.
--
--    .2.1        LoaderVersion        bootloader does not expose a version
--                                     (no fw_printenv, nothing in device-tree)
--    .3.1.4/.5   DipSwitch1/2         no physical DIP switch on this platform
--    .3.3.1.10.3 ApLoginNum           counted by an access point; a station
--                                     cannot know it
--    .3.3.2.4    TxMultiOctets        not reported by the driver
--    .3.3.2.7    TxFifoErrors         not reported by the driver
--    .3.3.2.11   RxMultiOctets        not reported by the driver
--    .3.3.2.12   RxFifoErrors         not reported by the driver
--    .3.3.5.x    WIFCert (8 objects)  EAP-TLS certificates; this product does
--                                     not use EAP authentication
--    .3.3.6.x    ConnectedNodeTable   table of stations associated to an access
--                                     point; not applicable to a station
--    .1.1.3      TrapInitDipsw        no physical DIP switch
-- ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

END
